comparisons.peer_summary: AMD agreed to acquire ZT Group Int'l, Inc. (ZT Systems) in August 2024 to extend data center infrastructure capabilities and accelerate time to market for AI solutions, with expected closure in the first half of fiscal 2025 subject to regulatory approvals and intent to seek a strategic partner for ZT's manufacturing business.
comparisons.comparison: Both companies are expanding their infrastructure capabilities to accelerate AI solutions and move towards general-purpose compute platforms. Intel (INTC) aims to transform networks and edge systems into general-purpose platforms running cloud-native software on programmable hardware to grow traditional and emerging markets. Similarly, AMD is extending its data center infrastructure capabilities through the acquisition of ZT Systems to accelerate time to market for its AI training and inferencing solutions. While Intel focuses on the strategic transformation of edge hardware and software ecosystems, AMD is executing specific infrastructure acquisitions to support its AI hardware deployment.

sentences.text: NEX aims to transform the world's networks and edge compute systems from fixed-function hardware to general-purpose compute, acceleration, and networking devices running cloud native software on programmable hardware.
We are leveraging our core strengths in compute, connectivity, software, and manufacturing at scale to grow traditional markets and to accelerate entry into emerging ones.

We also focused on extending our data center infrastructure capabilities by entering into an agreement in August 2024 to acquire ZT Group Int'l, Inc. (ZT Systems), a provider of AI and general purpose compute infrastructure for hyperscale computing companies.
We believe that with the acquisition of ZT Systems, we can accelerate time to market for our leadership AI training and inferencing solutions.

comparisons.peer_topic: Global Technology Scope and Product Portfolio
comparisons.peer_summary: Avago is a global technology leader designing semiconductor and infrastructure software solutions, including AI networking, home connectivity, and software for mainframe and cloud platforms, while also offering fibre channel storage area networking products.
comparisons.comparison: Both Intel and Avago describe their strategic positioning around broad infrastructure and software solutions that span from the cloud to the edge. Intel's Network and Edge (NEX) segment focuses on transforming edge compute systems and delivering platforms for cloud-to-edge digital transformation. Avago similarly positions itself as a provider of semiconductor and infrastructure software solutions, explicitly mentioning software for 'edge' platforms and AI networking. Both disclosures highlight a comprehensive portfolio approach to addressing modern data center and edge computing needs.

sentences.text: We have a broad portfolio of hardware and software platforms, tools, and ecosystem partnerships for the rapid digital transformation happening from the cloud to the edge.
We are leveraging our core strengths in compute, connectivity, software, and manufacturing at scale to grow traditional markets and to accelerate entry into emerging ones.
We are a global technology leader that designs, develops and supplies a broad range of semiconductor and infrastructure software solutions.

Our infrastructure software solutions help enterprises simplify their information technology environments so they can increase business velocity and flexibility, and enable customers to plan, develop, deliver, automate, manage and secure applications across mainframe, distributed, edge, mobile, and private and hybrid cloud platforms.
